name: Kalshi
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Kalshi is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Kalshi is a privately held company that operates a regulated exchange for event contracts. Its shares are not publicly traded and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1 billion Series G round announced on October 29, 2026, valued the company at $40 billion.

Founded in 2018 and based in New York, Kalshi runs an exchange regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission on which customers trade contracts tied to the outcomes of events. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

Shares reported by ARK Venture Fund (July 31, 2026)
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company.
round_notes: With the Series G announcement, Kalshi said its annualized trading volume had passed $1 trillion. In November 2026, Bloomberg reported that the company was in talks to raise new capital at a valuation of $65 billion. Kalshi has not announced a further round.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Wellington Management and Sequoia Capital co-led the Series G, with participation from Baillie Gifford, Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue, CapitalG and Morgan Stanley Investment Management. Coatue led the Series F, Paradigm led the Series C and Series E, and Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia Capital led the Series D. Other investors include IVP, ARK Invest and Y Combinator.
spv_sentence: Since 2022, 15 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Kalshi have filed with the SEC, 12 of them in 2026.
funds: Two SEC-registered funds report positions in Kalshi. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 55,974 shares, which it valued at $32.8 million, or $586.84 per share.
sources: Sources: Kalshi's announcements of its Series G, Series F, Series E, Series D and Series C; reports by CNBC (October 2026) and Bloomberg (November 2026); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D filings.
